title: Urutonde rwo kwisuzuma – Amashanyarazi n'itegeko rya Ohm
subject: Fysik
intro: Uru rutonde rukurikira intambwe z'ingenzi z'imfashanyigisho yo kwiga. Shyira akamenyetso ku byo wumva ko ubizi neza. Ibice bikurikirana intambwe ku yindi. Ingingo z'ubumenyi bwimbitse ziri hasi ni iz'ushaka kujya imbere kurushaho.

sections.title: 1. Umuyoboro w'amashanyarazi
items: Nshobora gusobanura ko umuyoboro w'amashanyarazi ari ukugenda kw'ibice by'amashanyarazi mu cyerekezo kimwe mu kintu gitwara amashanyarazi.
Nzi ko mu byuma ari elegitoroni zidafunze zigenda.
Nzi ko ingano y'umuyoboro w'amashanyarazi ipimwa muri ampere (A).
Nzi icyo icyerekezo gisanzwe cyemejwe cy'umuyoboro bivuze n'isano gifitanye n'igenda nyakuri ry'elegitoroni.
Nzi itandukaniro riri hagati y'amashanyarazi ahoraho (aturuka kuri batiri) n'amashanyarazi ahindagurika (aturuka ku isoketi yo ku rukuta), mu buryo bworoshye.

sections.title: 2. Umuvuduko w'amashanyarazi
items: Nshobora gusobanura umuvuduko w'amashanyarazi nk'imbaraga zituma ibice by'amashanyarazi bigenda mu muzunguruko.
Nzi ko umuvuduko w'amashanyarazi upimwa muri volt (V).
Nzi imivuduko y'amashanyarazi isanzwe yo mu buzima bwa buri munsi: 1,5 V (batiri), 12 V (batiri y'imodoka) na 230 V (isoketi yo ku rukuta).
Nzi ko umuvuduko w'amashanyarazi upimwa na voltimetero ihujwe mu nzira zitandukanye ku gikoresho gipimwa.

sections.title: 3. Ibitwara n'ibidatwara amashanyarazi
items: Nshobora gutanga ingero z'ibitwara amashanyarazi neza (umuringa, aluminium, ifeza) kandi nkasobanura impamvu ibyuma bitwara amashanyarazi.
Nshobora gutanga ingero z'ibidatwara amashanyarazi neza (plastike, umupira, ikirahure, umwuka wumye).
Nzi ko semikonduktere iri hagati y'ibitwara n'ibidatwara amashanyarazi, kandi ko ari yo shingiro ry'ibikoresho bya elegitoronike.
Nzi ko amazi arimo umunyu na yo atwara amashanyarazi, kandi ko iyo ari imwe mu mpamvu amashanyarazi ateye ibyago hafi y'amazi.

sections.title: 4. Inzitizi y'amashanyarazi na ohm
items: Nshobora gusobanura inzitizi y'amashanyarazi nk'ikibangamira umuyoboro mu kintu gitwara amashanyarazi.
Nzi ko inzitizi ipimwa muri ohm (Ω).
Nzi ko ikintu gitwara amashanyarazi kirekire kandi cyoroheje kigira inzitizi nini kurusha kigufi kandi cyibyibushye.
Nzi ko inzitizi mu kintu gitwara amashanyarazi cy'icyuma yiyongera iyo ubushyuhe bwiyongereye.
Nshobora gusobanura mu buryo bworoshye icyo superkonduktivite bivuze (gutwara amashanyarazi nta nzitizi).

sections.title: 5. Itegeko rya Ohm
items: Nzi itegeko rya Ohm mu buryo bwa U = R · I.
Nshobora guhindura formule nkabona I = U / R na R = U / I.
Nshobora kubara umuyoboro iyo umuvuduko w'amashanyarazi n'inzitizi bizwi.
Nshobora kubara inzitizi iyo umuvuduko w'amashanyarazi n'umuyoboro bizwi.
Nzi impamvu insinga y'imbere mu itara irushaho gushyuha no kumurika iyo umuvuduko w'amashanyarazi wiyongereye.

sections.title: 6. Guhuza amatara bikurikiranye no guhuza amatara mu nzira zitandukanye
items: Nshobora kumenya mu gishushanyo iyo amatara ahujwe bikurikiranye cyangwa mu nzira zitandukanye.
Nzi ibiba ku yandi matara iyo itara rimwe ryangiritse mu guhuza bikurikiranye.
Nzi ibiba ku yandi matara iyo itara rimwe ryangiritse mu guhuza mu nzira zitandukanye.
Nzi impamvu amatara amurika buhoro mu guhuza bikurikiranye kurusha mu guhuza mu nzira zitandukanye, iyo umuvuduko w'amashanyarazi wa batiri ari umwe.
Nshobora gutanga ingero z'aho guhuza bikurikiranye n'aho guhuza mu nzira zitandukanye bikoreshwa mu buzima bwa buri munsi.

sections.title: 7. Guhuza batiri bikurikiranye no guhuza batiri mu nzira zitandukanye
items: Nzi ko batiri ebyiri zihujwe bikurikiranye zitanga umuvuduko w'amashanyarazi ukubye kabiri, ariko umuyoboro ntarengwa ungana n'uwa batiri imwe.
Nzi ko batiri ebyiri zihujwe mu nzira zitandukanye zitanga umuvuduko w'amashanyarazi umwe, ariko zimara hafi igihe cyikubye kabiri.
Nshobora kubona mu gishushanyo cy'umuzunguruko niba batiri zihujwe bikurikiranye cyangwa mu nzira zitandukanye.
Nzi impamvu batiri zo mu itoroshi zisanzwe zihujwe bikurikiranye.

sections.title: 8. Ibishushanyo by'imizunguruko
items: Nshobora kumenya ibimenyetso bikunze gukoreshwa: batiri, itara, interupteri, inzitizi, amperimetero na voltimetero.
Nshobora gutandukanya umuzunguruko ufunze n'ufunguye mu gishushanyo.
Nzi ko amperimetero ihujwe bikurikiranye n'umuzunguruko.
Nzi ko voltimetero ihujwe mu nzira zitandukanye ku gikoresho gipimwa.
Nshobora gushushanya igishushanyo cyoroshye cy'umuzunguruko ufite batiri, interupteri n'itara.

sections.title: 9. Ubushobozi n'ingufu
items: Nzi ko ubushobozi bupimwa muri watt (W).
Nzi isano P = U · I kandi nshobora kubara ubushobozi bw'igikoresho iyo umuvuduko w'amashanyarazi n'umuyoboro bizwi.
Nzi ko ingufu ari ubushobozi bukubye igihe: W = P · t.
Nzi icyo isaha ya kilowatt (kWh) ari cyo kandi nshobora kugereranya ingano y'ingufu zimwe mu bikoresho byo mu rugo zikoresha.
Nshobora gusobanura impamvu igikoresho gishyushya amazi cya 2000 W gikoresha umuyoboro mwinshi cyane kurusha itara rya 40 W.

sections.title: 10. Umutekano w'amashanyarazi – igikingira amashanyarazi n'igikingira ku byago by'amashanyarazi ajya mu butaka
items: Nzi icyo igikingira amashanyarazi gikora n'impamvu gihari.
Nshobora gusobanura impamvu ubushyuhe bukabije buteje ibyago bushobora kwiyongera mu mugozi unyuzwamo umuyoboro urenze urugero.
Nzi icyo igikingira ku byago by'amashanyarazi ajya mu butaka gikoreshwa.
Nzi icyo ubutaka bukingira ari cyo n'impamvu umugozi ufite ifishi ihujwe n'ubutaka ugira insinga eshatu.
Nshobora gusobanura mu buryo bworoshye impamvu amashanyarazi hafi y'amazi ateye ibyago byinshi cyane.

sections.title: 11. Ibyago n'amabwiriza mu rugo
items: Nshobora gutanga nibura ingero eshatu z'ibihe biteje ibyago by'amashanyarazi mu rugo.
Nzi impamvu tutagomba gucomeka ibikoresho byinshi cyane mu isoketi imwe ifite ibyinjizwamo byinshi.
Nzi icyo ikimenyetso cya CE bivuze n'impamvu ari ingenzi.
Nzi ko umugozi wangiritse ugomba gusimburwa, kandi ntugomba na rimwe gusanwa by'agateganyo.
Nzi impamvu isoketi zo mu cyumba cyo kwiyuhagiriramo zigomba kugira igikingira ku byago by'amashanyarazi ajya mu butaka.

sections.title: 12. Amashanyarazi mu muryango
items: Nshobora gutanga ingero z'ibyo twe muri Suwede dukoresha amashanyarazi menshi cyane.
Ndumva itandukaniro riri hagati y'ingufu (kWh ku mwaka) n'ubushobozi (W mu gihe runaka).
Nshobora gutekereza mu buryo bworoshye ku mpamvu ari byiza kwita ku mashanyarazi dukoresha.
Nzi ko uko amashanyarazi akorwa bizasobanurwa mu gice gikurikira, Rukuruzi na induction.

sections.title: ★ Ubumenyi bwimbitse
sections.note: Ni ubushake. Ku ushaka kujya imbere kurushaho.
items: Nshobora gusobanura impamvu inzitizi mu cyuma yiyongera uko ubushyuhe bwiyongera, kubera ko atomi zinyeganyega cyane.
Nshobora gusobanura mu buryo bworoshye ibiba muri superkonduktere n'impamvu bidakora mu bushyuhe busanzwe bw'icyumba.
Nshobora gusobanura impamvu inzitizi yose mu guhuza mu nzira zitandukanye iba nto kurusha inzitizi ntoya muri zo.
Nshobora kuvana formule P = U · I ku kuba ubushobozi ari ingufu ku gihe, kandi umuvuduko w'amashanyarazi ukaba ari ingufu ku buri gice cy'amashanyarazi.
Nshobora gutekereza ku mpamvu ubushyuhe butakara mu nsinga bwiyongera uko umuyoboro wikuba inshuro zawo (kare y'umuyoboro).
